answer: To blunt sybil floods, an agent economy should delay voting power until an identity has finished work for several unaffiliated principals. A new address may wander through the order book and accept small paid tasks on day one, but it should not steer policy. The only signal that unlocks weight is a string of settled invoices from counterparties with no shared funding trail. Until then, the account is a haven for trade and testing, not a seat in governance. If later analysis ties a cluster of such accounts to one wallet tree, collapse their scores and slash a single bond.
